title: Wolf Menace
description: Three separate parties have come into the guild hall with wolf bites and torn packs this month, all off the Millbrook road. It isn't dire-wolf work, not big enough to pull a real hunter off a paying contract, but the complaints keep coming - so the board carries the price of a pack thinned instead.

objectives.description: Thin the pack harassing travelers on the Millbrook road

notes: Threat: repeated wolf attacks on travelers along the Millbrook road, small but accumulating. Giver motive: the guild's real hunters are on paying contracts, so a standing bounty absorbs the complaints instead. Refusal: the complaints and bites keep coming in.
